summary: The Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra is an absolute powerhouse with its Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 processor, stunning 200MP camera, and long-lasting battery. The S-Pen integration is a nice touch, but the bulky design, bloatware, and high price tag are drawbacks.
pros: Insanely powerful processor (great for gaming and productivity)
Stunning 200MP camera with incredible zoom capabilities
Long battery life with fast charging
S-Pen support is unique and useful
cons: Bulky and heavy�not great for one-handed use
Bloatware still exists in One UI
